svg.title: COBOL to Java: where we stand
svg.text: COBOL to Java: where we stand
Real mainframe COBOL translated to Java by fixed rules, and checked one evidence step at a time.
'Same output' means equal to GnuCOBOL run under IBM's documented rules; not yet measured on a real IBM mainframe (z/OS). Built from commit a889c6a41 on 2026-11-14.
Measured from the first run on the estate, before any fix, then after each merged PR. Never in the totals below. Public code may be in a model's training data; the translator uses no model.
Blind draws at first contact (1 so far)
first contact: the engine as it was, before any fix
First try: one attempt, frozen engine
same output on the first try
28 / 28 same output after engine fixes (never first-try)
deterministic port vs GnuCOBOL, every scenario
Each panel: across, trial PRs since first contact (0 to 100, the same for every draw); up, the share of its programs.
L2 needs cases, written only after first contact (owner amendment, blind 1). First try counts the frozen engine only: a later fix never turns a miss into a first-try pass.
Each row is one codebase. Left: how far its programs have climbed (an L5 program counts at L4 here). Right: its planted-bug work (L5). Our own test estates sit below, never in a total.
Our test suite: L5 not yet started
Levels L0-L4: how far each program has climbed
1. Training codebases: 6 IBM and AWS samples
We develop against these, so they are not blind tests; code we had never seen is measured apart, from first contact (above).

svg.text: Every branch is net of 494 reviewed infeasible, 5 undefined by IBM, 1 practically unreachable (owner ruling) outcomes, each named in its evidence report.
L5 so far: 15,522 of the 26,812 planted bugs run were caught by a test; 5,207 more are explained as harmless
(equivalent or unreachable: reviewed claims, not yet audited).
61% of the 45,535 possible planted bugs have been run.
Separate from these: hand-written ports, not the translator, score 86.8% adjusted and 68.0% raw over 59 ports. They feed no level.
The 3 not at every branch yet, each named: none dropped
All still count in the 129. 3 stop where a ruling stops them; every other program is at L4 or above.
RECORD KEY names a WORKING-STORAGE item; IBM's compiler rejects the source
LE condition handling and SOAP faults that no oracle can back
Written by us to break the translator, never in a total: 129 CICS test programs, one CICS behaviour each and 4 Open World practice codebases (pinned v0.7.0).
The practice codebases come before translator support and are not translated yet by design (their first run is measured once, rule 5); the scanner reads 43 of their 44 planted traps correctly.

svg.text: Real codebases mix decades: 1980s programs LINK 1990s ones that call 2010s Db2 code. Each program is dated by the features it uses (era_tags.py); 13 show no dating clue.
8 works, 16 partial, 1 reads only, 1 refused, 1 nothing. Counted from the code on every run; a bar appears only where IBM publishes a full list to count against.
8 tables, 71 rules, 153 test vectors, 162 matrix cells
part of the rules above: depth, not extra rules
17 member layouts the engine and translator both resolve
extensionless and program-extension members, lowercase, nested COPY, OF library, deep directories
Gap found by Blind 1: 28 of 29 first-contact misses were copybooks (#8074, #8111)
translated from IBM's text; GnuCOBOL has no JSON, so no oracle backs it (register X77: ASSUMED)
Gap found by the census rehearsal: 2 programs needed it (#7524)
US, European, Arabic, Hebrew, Greek, Turkish; Japanese, Chinese, Korean
comma decimal point, pound / euro / rupee signs, lakh grouping, rounding, Lilian dates; 0 failing cells (Cultural Gauntlet)
members as raw exported mainframe bytes
EBCDIC incl. Arabic and Japanese DBCS, Shift-JIS, UTF-8 with and without BOM
FCT, PCT, PPT, DCT, TST, SIT, SRT, JCT, TCT, MCT, PLT, DSNCRCT
12 tables read into the resource map; not run
18 more IBM statement keywords, beyond the modelled ones, each refused by name, never dropped
Tested by Blind 1: its 17 SQL statements all translated at first contact; the rest pinned (#8075, #8146)
keyed read, write and browse, in 16 equivalence cases
browse by relative byte address under CICS
0 of 7 rules match IBM; CICS calls only
calls run on our own model, so no rule matches yet
SORT, MERGE, COPY, INCLUDE, OMIT, OUTREC; 4 key formats
REPRO and plain copies; other commands refused
run or bypass per step (COND), CardDemo's 8 COND jobs: 34 of 34 answers
answers written from IBM's JCL Reference before the evaluator ran
143 jobs read in 213 JCL members; 18 depend on COND / IF
